verdict.rationale: Pipeline CRM's feature page says you can drag and drop deals through stages on a visual board, with value and next step shown on each card. It also says you can define your own pipeline stages, which covers every element of the story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and in-depth first-party documentation of stage configuration beyond marketing feature copy.

support.subject: As a founder, I can track deals on a visual pipeline with customizable stages and drag-and-drop updates
